name: Kamishiro Aki
source:
Yuu's mother who dotes on Yuu. [spoiler]Actually his biological father.[/spoiler]

Her words and actions are natural, but she has many secrets.

In the sequel, envying that her beloved son is having a busy school life, she has been assigned to Lirienne Girls' Academy as an insurance doctor.


[Partially translated from the game's [url=http://www.masterup.net/momoiro/product/josou4/index.html]official homepage[/url].]
